posts.name: ReSO AI
posts.tagline: Get discovered & recommended when customers ask AI
posts.description: ReSO is a generative engine optimization platform that helps brands show up in AI search results. It’s built for founders, CMOs, and growth teams who want to turn buyer intent in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AIO into visibility, citations, and traffic. What makes it different is that it doesn’t just track rankings, it analyzes intent, competitors, content gaps, and technical issues, then turns them into priority actions to improve AI recommendations.

posts.name: Onepin
posts.tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right
posts.description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

posts.name: Claude Dashboards & Motion
posts.tagline: Ask Claude for live dashboards and animated explainers
posts.description: Claude Dashboards and Claude Motion are beta artifacts in Claude. Dashboards connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse or Salesforce and turns a plain language question into a live dashboard that refreshes as your data changes, with the query behind every number. Motion turns reports, charts and walkthroughs into short animations written as code, so you can edit any word, number or timing, then export an MP4. Dashboards is on paid plans, Motion on Team and Enterprise.

posts.name: Cue
posts.tagline: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing
posts.description: Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

posts.name: Microsoft-Decision-1
posts.tagline: Microsoft’s decision model for agents and workflows
posts.description: Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Give it fixed options and it returns a calibrated probability for each in a single pass, as structured output software can act on directly. Post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B, it is about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency, per Microsoft. Available now in Microsoft Foundry at $0.042 per million input tokens, with free output.

posts.name: Firefox 157
posts.tagline: A brand new Firefox is here
posts.description: Say hello to a refreshed design and more ways to make it feel like home. Your bookmarks, extensions, and shortcuts are right where you left them.

posts.name: Kitbar
posts.tagline: Your dev tools, in one bar.
posts.description: A thin bar on the edge of your screen shows how your Vercel deploys, GitHub checks, Stripe payments and Claude Code limits are doing. Point at a ring for the details and act from there. No account, no server; keys stay in your keychain. Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Skreno
posts.tagline: Record, edit and share videos, all in your browser
posts.description: Skreno is a video studio in your browser: record, edit and share in one place. Record your screen and camera as separate tracks, then edit in Studio: pick a layout, cut silences, and add animated captions and titles. Share one link with a transcript, AI summary and comments on the exact second. Send a request link and anyone can record for you, no account needed. Bug reports come with the console log attached.

posts.name: Skymir
posts.tagline: Google Drive sync for Linux
posts.description: Skymir mirrors your Google Drive folders to Linux with two-way sync, double-click Google Docs shortcuts, and a native GTK tray. Local saves upload within seconds; changes made in Drive arrive within about a minute. Deletes go to the trash on both sides, and a sync that would delete more than half your files is refused. $19 one-time, 14-day free trial, no subscription.

posts.name: Maildun for Mac
posts.tagline: Design on-brand emails by hand, with AI, or over MCP
posts.description: Maildun for Mac is an agentic email builder for macOS. Design by hand in the drag-and-drop editor, or connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok with your own API key: the assistant edits your design live, as a proposal you accept or reject. Turn on the built-in MCP server and Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can create and edit emails too. Plus workspaces per client, brand kits with shadcn-style component styles, saved sections, media on your own R2 or S3 bucket, and publishing to maildun.com.

posts.name: Lune
posts.tagline: The search engine built for scientific AI agents
posts.description: Lune is Exa.ai for scientific research. It connects AI agents to research knowledge and tools built for scientific workflows, and provides high-quality knowledge grounding based on papers from top-tier academic conferences. 10x the efficiency and trustworthiness of literature review, experimental design, writing and peer review. From early ideas to publication, it helps researchers and technical teams move faster with traceable sources, deeper grounding, and rigorous, evidence-backed decisions.

posts.name: TapNoise
posts.tagline: A tiny desktop pet that reacts to every key you press
posts.description: Meet Tappy, a little keycap who lives on your Mac's desktop. Tappy sweats when you type fast, gets dizzy when you slap your MacBook, eats when the charger goes in and naps when you're away. Coding with Claude Code, Codex or Cursor? Tappy chimes when your agent is done and sweats until you knock twice on your MacBook to answer. Plus 20 keyboard sounds, a lift alarm for café tables and Clean Mode for wiping the keys. Pay once, no subscription.

posts.name: API Claws by Buda
posts.tagline: Build self-improving agent harness with one API
posts.description: API Claws is Buda's developer-facing Agent API. Create hosted AI agents with Drive memory, model routing, managed runtime, observability, sessions, and embeddable product experiences, without building the full agent infrastructure yourself.

posts.name: GitGlow
posts.tagline: Review your code and your agents' changes before you ship
posts.description: GitGlow brings precise staging, clear history, and a checkout-aware terminal into one local Git workspace. Pro adds review marks and checks that become stale after edits, plus managed agent and release tools. Free for private local clones; no account needed.

posts.name: New Windows Search
posts.tagline: Windows Search now takes action, not just finds files
posts.description: Microsoft is rebuilding Windows Search to help you do things, not just find them. The new experience is faster, cleaner, and lets you take action directly from the search box. Switch to dark mode, toggle Bluetooth, adjust brightness, mute your PC, or arrange windows simply by typing what you need. Built on WinUI 3 with improved search relevance, it's rolling out to Windows Insiders first, with richer previews and more actions on the way.

posts.name: History Monk
posts.tagline: Fast History Search, Export & Bulk Delete
posts.description: History Monk replaces your browser's history page. Type a few letters and the page you want shows up. Filter by site, day or hour, see where your time goes, and clear out the clutter. 100% local and private.

posts.name: Hypervibe
posts.tagline: Run your AI coding agents on one infinite board
posts.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents side by side on an infinite board. Hypervibe brings real terminals, agent status, teams, voice control and live previews into one native Mac app. Use the agent accounts you already have. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon.

posts.name: Pawse
posts.tagline: A cute 3D pet that reminds you to drink water & take breaks
posts.description: Pawse is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app. A cute 3D pet walks onto your screen to remind you to drink water, keep habits like stretching every 30 minutes, and take screen-time breaks, with an optional hard block.

posts.name: Fluence
posts.tagline: Listen to your documents. Nothing leaves your phone
posts.description: Fluence. reads your PDFs, EPUBs, Word, OpenDocument, Rich Text and Markdown files aloud — in a natural voice that ships inside the app, in 31 languages, with nothing to download first. Follow the highlighted text as it plays, ask the document a question and get an answer drawn from its own passages, or record your own voice and have it read back to you. No account, no server, no subscription: one payment, and it works offline for good.

posts.name: Baby Desk
posts.tagline: Let your baby smash the keyboard and your work stays safe
posts.description: Baby Desk turns your Mac into a full-screen baby playground that absorbs keys and clicks, including ⌘Q and ⌘Tab, while your work stays untouched. Stars, letters, and balloons keep little hands busy. Launch offer: $1.99 (regularly $4.99). macOS 13+.

posts.name: Toolaby
posts.tagline: Get paid for your Chrome extension, in two lines of code
posts.description: Toolaby adds licences, subscriptions, free trials and a paywall to your Chrome extension: one command, or ask your coding agent. Payments land in your own Stripe account. No backend to host. 0.5% of each sale, or Pro at $25 a month with no fee.

posts.name: Buffer
posts.tagline: Search everything you copy, even text inside screenshots
posts.description: Buffer 3.0 is a free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS. Everything you copy text, links, images is saved to a searchable local history, one ⇧⌘V away. It reads text inside screenshots with on-device Vision OCR, lets you edit any saved snippet inline, and organizes clips with tags, bookmarks, and multi-select paste. v3.0 adds an interactive image canvas, history tiers up to unlimited, and clipboard noise suppression. MIT-licensed. No accounts, no cloud — everything stays on your Mac.

posts.name: Naarchy
posts.tagline: A little island for everything on your Linux desktop
posts.description: Naarchy brings a file shelf, searchable clipboard history, music controls, a focus timer, and your calendar to the top of your Linux desktop. Native Rust and GTK4. Built for Omarchy and Hyprland, with or without a physical notch. Free, MIT licensed, and open source. Clipboard and shelf content stay on your machine. No account. No telemetry.

posts.name: put·here
posts.tagline: A place to collect notes to organize them later
posts.description: Most note apps want an answer the moment you save something: a title, a folder, a tag. Ideas show up before they have a shape. put·here is a canvas for the Mac where text, links, pictures and files land wherever you drop them — paste, drag, or press ⌃⌥P from any app. Step back and the whole canvas reads at a glance. Every canvas is a real folder of plain files on your Mac, so your notes stay yours. Free to start.

posts.name: KernelAI
posts.tagline: Private, offline AI for iPhone and Android
posts.description: Run 50+ AI models locally on iPhone and Android. Chat, read PDFs and documents with on-device RAG, understand images with vision models, and write code offline. Dictate prompts, customize responses and import GGUF models (experimental). On iPhone, use Siri, Shortcuts and Apple's built-in AI on supported devices. Add optional web search with your own API key. Free, with no account, ads or subscription. Download a model once, then use it offline. Your local chats and documents stay on your device.

posts.name: Letra
posts.tagline: Copy the text your Mac won’t let you select
posts.description: A link in a screen share. Code in a video. Text in a scanned PDF. Press ⇧⌘2, drag, and paste. Letra turns on-screen text into clipboard text, entirely on your Mac. Includes QR scanning, multilingual OCR, and searchable history. $5.99 once. No subscription.

posts.name: Museum of Models
posts.tagline: Every answer 371 AI models gave to the same questions
posts.description: Every new AI model since May 2024, asked the same 85 questions. All 15,639 answers kept as they came out, on a globe you can spin and open. Nothing is ranked.

posts.name: Underplane
posts.tagline: Spotting interception game
posts.description: Underplane turns planes flying over your city into a game. It tracks nearby aircraft in real time, works out exactly where you need to stand to have one pass directly overhead, then gives you a countdown to race there before it flies past. No aviation knowledge needed — just run outside and look up. Existing flight trackers show you data on a map; Underplane turns it into something you actually go and play.

posts.name: The Computer Game
posts.tagline: Build the best computer, from stone tools to your own chips
posts.description: A free browser strategy game. Build the best computer you can, from stone tools to processors and chips you design. Play alone or with an AI agent.

posts.name: ej
posts.tagline: An 11MB local model for typed decisions in one pass
posts.description: I built ej for a narrower problem than general classification: given some state and a set of decision questions whose options can be defined at runtime, return a probability distribution for each question in one pass. It handles choice, yes/no, and ordered scores, runs on CPU, needs no token generation, and ships as one 11.4 MB model file. The repo includes training, evaluation, adaptation, packed weights, and the benchmark harness.

posts.name: AgentDock
posts.tagline: Answer Claude Code & Codex from one Inbox, in any terminal
posts.description: AgentDock keeps Claude Code, Codex and your other coding agents on the edge of your Mac's screen. See who's working, answer every question and permission prompt from one Inbox with a keystroke (typed straight into cmux, tmux, iTerm, WezTerm, kitty or herdr), and message any agent from any app with ⌥⌥. Finished work gets a recap, written on your Mac. No account; nothing leaves your Mac. $19 once, after a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: AdsNotch
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac’s screen into ad space and earn money
posts.description: AdsNotch is a native macOS app that shows ads in a small, unobtrusive screen notch and shares the advertising revenue with you. Ads can seamlessly expand when relevant events happen, then disappear when you're done.

posts.name: PocketWebTools for Mac
posts.tagline: Local AI chat, transcription and video tools in one Mac app
posts.description: PocketWebTools for Mac is one app that runs open models up to 35B parameters on your Apple Silicon Mac, with the tools built around them. Chat and summarize. Transcribe files, calls and system audio with speaker labels. Cut long videos into captioned vertical clips, or edit a video by deleting words from its transcript. Upscale photos at full resolution, turn PDFs and scans into text and read any text aloud. Your files and chats never leave your Mac. No account. $99 once, free lifetime updates.

posts.name: Tuck
posts.tagline: A tidy menu bar for macOS 27
posts.description: Tuck keeps the menu bar icons you use and tucks the rest away. Arrange three bars by dragging, open any hidden icon from the Tuck Bar with one click, find icons by name, and keep your order after restarts and updates. Built for macOS 27. Free.

posts.name: Isly
posts.tagline: Your MacBook notch, brought to life.
posts.description: Isly turns the MacBook notch into a living control center: music from any app with cover art and scrubber, live timers and calendar events, clean volume/brightness readouts, and more - all without leaving your workflow. Light on resources (≈0.2% CPU idle, ~49 MB RAM), smooth animations, and a one-time €3.99 license with free updates. For macOS 14+ with a notch.

posts.name: PixRater
posts.tagline: Cull and rate your photos faster
posts.description: PixRater is a fast, 100% local photo culling tool. It groups RAW+JPEG pairs, auto-evaluates face sharpness, and uses private AI for keywording. Ratings save to EXIF/XMP metadata, and an integrated local MCP server lets you connect custom AI tools.

posts.name: Notchzy
posts.tagline: Interactive dynamic island for windows
posts.description: Notchzy is a dynamic island which is highly interactive and useful specifically for windows PC and unlike other alternatives in the market its a very lightweight app hardly using any extra power on your PC.

posts.name: Rank Kiwi
posts.tagline: Find top-performing content on Instagram & YouTube
posts.description: Free Chrome extension for Instagram & YouTube content research. Compare creators, analyse Reels and Shorts, track engagement, and discover outlier content worth studying.

posts.name: Things take time
posts.tagline: Track anything. Visualize everything.
posts.description: Things take time helps you track the things that matter — habits, metrics, and everything in between. See everything side by side, month by month, in a simple grid inspired by pen-and-paper notebook trackers.

posts.name: Reeborn: Shadow Work & Breath
posts.tagline: AI app that remembers, spots patterns and goes deep
posts.description: Launching on World Mental Health Day. Most wellness apps forget you the moment you close them. Reeborn remembers. Aria, an AI guide, connects what you share across weeks and gently shows the patterns you keep repeating, in your own words, on an Inner map. Kael guides shadow work step by step. Breathwork and meditation bring you back to your body. Private by design: conversations deleted after 7 days, Face ID lock, export or delete anytime. Not therapy. Free to start on iPhone.

posts.name: Revenue Scout
posts.tagline: Find social media leads, with replies ready to review
posts.description: Find people who need what you sell across Reddit, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Revenue Scout checks buying intent and offer fit, filters weak matches, and prioritizes relevant opportunities. Choose a lead and get a reply grounded in the conversation and your business, ready to review, edit and post from your own account. Start free on Reddit, no credit card or connected social accounts required. Platform coverage varies by plan.

posts.name: Toonify
posts.tagline: Create a custom animated mascot for your brand
posts.description: Toonify turns a one-line description into an animated mascot for your app or website. Pick a base, describe your character, choose its moves (wave, jump, dance, blink and more), and download one lightweight Rive or Lottie file. Play any move with a single line of code on iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native and the web. No designers, no animators, no heavy GIFs or videos. Start free, then pay as you go from $5

posts.name: Vidu Q4
posts.tagline: Bring up to 15 images and 3 voices into one 4K scene
posts.description: Explore Vidu Q4, an AI video generation model with native audio, faster motion quality, and stronger prompt control for creative work.

posts.name: Zumie
posts.tagline: Screen Studio-style recordings, right in Chrome
posts.description: Zumie is a Chrome extension that makes screen recordings look edited. Auto zoom follows your clicks, and you get a smooth cursor, click effects, a keystroke overlay, webcam bubble and backgrounds on top. New since the last launch: auto zoom rebuilt to frame what you click, a styled cursor and click effects, full resolution on Retina and a faster export. Works on Windows, Mac, Linux and Chromebook. No signup, nothing uploaded. Free with a watermark, or $49 once.

posts.name: FuelBar for Mac and Windows
posts.tagline: Every AI coding limit, on the edge of your screen.
posts.description: FuelBar sits on the edge of your screen and shows how much of your Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Freebuff and Antigravity limits you’ve used. It warns you at 80% and says when a session finishes. No account needed. Pay once for Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Weatherling
posts.tagline: Make it rain and snow on your Mac desktop
posts.description: Weatherling brings rain, snow, wind, and leaves to your Mac desktop windows. It is private, lightweight, and playful, with collectible Lings™ who wander through the weather. Put rare Lings in rare boxes for the highest score and share with friends.

posts.name: DroidPass Password Manager
posts.tagline: Passwords, passkeys and 2FA codes, offline first
posts.description: DroidPass keeps passwords, passkeys, 2FA codes, cards and Wi-Fi keys in an AES-256 vault that opens offline. Move in directly from Apple Passwords, Dashlane or 1Password - no exported file sitting in your Downloads folder. Free tier, no ads, no tracking.

posts.name: File Expiry
posts.tagline: Give your files an expiry date. Keep your Mac clutter-free.
posts.description: Files pile up on your Mac faster than you realize. Temporary downloads, screenshots, and old documents often stay around long after you need them. FileExpiry helps you stay organized by letting you assign expiration dates to files. ✅ Prevent unnecessary file clutter ✅ Set expiration dates for temporary files ✅ Spend less time cleaning up manually ✅ Keep your Mac organized effortlessly ✅ No subscriptions, just $7.99 lifetime! A simple, lightweight macOS utility

posts.name: CyanFocus
posts.tagline: Auto-zoom screen recorder that blurs your secrets
posts.description: CyanFocus is a demo recorder for Windows. Every click becomes a smooth, editable zoom, and your cursor is redrawn cleanly in one of five styles. It also finds API keys, emails and card numbers in your recording and blurs them, frame by frame, even while you scroll. Everything runs on your PC: captions, blur, export up to 4K. Free to use; Pro removes the watermark.

posts.name: BatteryBud for Mac
posts.tagline: Battery levels and history for every device, in one click
posts.description: BatteryBud shows every battery you own in your Mac menu bar: this Mac, other Macs, iPhone, iPad, AirPods left bud, right bud and case, Beats, keyboard, mouse, gaming controllers, UPS, and more. It keeps a charge history, health and cycle count for each one, and your iPhone and iPad report over Wi-Fi after a one-time cable setup. It records each charging session, how long it took and how fast it charged. Pay once, use forever, a year of updates included.

posts.name: Rankdesk AI-Writer
posts.tagline: Scale your SEO on autopilot (Rank in Google & ChatGPT)
posts.description: Rankdesk is the first automated SEO tool that auto-writes and auto-publishes both articles & pages based on your niche, competitors, and what actually works today to rank on Google and get cited by ChatGPT. What makes us different? ✅ Write and publish both Articles & Pages on autopilot ✅ Local SEO optimization ✅ Convert articles into optimized Google Business Profile Posts ✅ Create articles and pages you need on the go ✅ Works for every site: from Custom to Shopify, from Webflow to WordPress.

posts.name: Nimmi
posts.tagline: Meal planning for the way you actually eat
posts.description: Most meal planners assume one kind of kitchen. Nimmi plans breakfast, lunch and dinner for mixed and multicultural homes: 193 recipes across 19 cuisines, from West African and Somali to Gujarati, Filipino and Mexican. Food rules (halal, vegetarian, vegan, no beef, no nuts, gluten free) are never broken. Your grocery list follows your store's real aisle order, from Walmart to Patel Brothers and H Mart. Import recipes from TikTok or Instagram and cook step by step. No account needed.

posts.name: Trailback for Mac & Windows
posts.tagline: Search your computer the way you remember it
posts.description: Lost a file, page or screenshot? Describe it and Trailback finds it, even if you forgot the name, folder or browser. 100% offline. Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Stepshots
posts.tagline: Record clickable product demos from your browser or CLI
posts.description: Interactive demo software for recording product demos with a browser extension or CLI. Edit, share, embed, run guided tours, and track engagement. Free tier.

posts.name: typed.cc
posts.tagline: Show how much of your email you actually typed
posts.description: typed.cc is a chrome extension that tracks how much of an email you actually typed, and adds a signed badge. no data leaves your browser except the final score.

posts.name: Linkquire
posts.tagline: Find guest posts and link insertions that fit your brand
posts.description: Share your brief and receive publishing opportunities from suppliers. Compare audience fit, prices and editorial terms, then unlock assessments, contacts and content plans for guest posts or link insertions.

posts.name: Dimmy.app
posts.tagline: Turn your voice into a superpower! On your terms.
posts.description: Dimmy is an open-source voice app for macOS and Windows. Dictate clean text into any app with local Whisper, rewrite text by voice, and turn meetings into structured recaps. Bring your own AI (Claude, OpenAI, GEmini, your ChatGPT/Claude sub, or a local model). Free from source.

posts.name: First Words
posts.tagline: Picture flashcards for toddlers, your own photos and voice.
posts.description: First Words is a calm, ad-free flashcard app for children aged 1 to 3. Tap a card to hear the word, swipe to see the next one. Big friendly pictures, one word at a time, and a clear voice that says it out loud. No menus, no timers, no scores – just words. Everything in the app is free. First Words Pro, with new packs every month and more voices, is coming soon

posts.name: pooml (Poor Man's Logger)
posts.tagline: Single-binary logs and metrics on SQLite, queried with SQL
posts.description: pooml is a logs and metrics server that runs on peanuts: one small binary, happy on the cheapest VPS. Point your services at it, and five minutes after install you have logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts on your phone. You query it all in plain SQL, the language you and your AI assistant already know. Your data stays in three SQLite files you can copy or open with any SQLite tool. Open source (AGPL).

posts.name: Prime Inference
posts.tagline: Fast, reliable serving for frontier open models
posts.description: Prime Inference is Prime Intellect's serving platform for frontier open-source models, with serverless endpoints and reserved capacity across multiple datacenters on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. It's OpenAI compatible, fails over automatically between datacenters, and offers unified billing and team usage tracking. Its GLM-5.3 endpoint went live on OpenRouter on Sept 22 with a near-zero tool-call error rate and 100% uptime since launch, per Prime Intellect.

posts.name: Token Monster
posts.tagline: A pixel pet for Claude Code that eats your tokens
posts.description: Token Monster is a pixel-art pet in a side pane of Claude Code. It eats every token Claude streams. Its size shows how full your context is, its glow shows your usage limits, and its face shows what Claude is doing. Free and open source.

posts.name: NotchClean
posts.tagline: The Dynamic Island for Windows
posts.description: NotchClean is a lightweight Windows control center for system cleanup, live CPU/RAM monitoring, clipboard history, media controls, and a drag-and-drop File Shelf, all inside a Dynamic Island-style floating notch. Built with Tauri + Rust. One-time lifetime license.

posts.name: KONWA
posts.tagline: Real-time voice translation for any app on Mac & Windows
posts.description: KONWA translates your voice as you speak and plays it through a virtual microphone, so the other side of a call, game or livestream hears you in their language. It works in any app that lets you pick a mic (Zoom, Teams, Discord, OBS…) and they install nothing. Listen Translation captions what they say in yours. • Sub-second latency, 40+ languages • Preset voices, or clone your own • Custom glossaries for names and jargon macOS & Windows. 10 free minutes.

posts.name: First Words
posts.tagline: Picture flashcards for toddlers, your own photos and voice.
posts.description: First Words is a calm, ad-free flashcard app for children aged 1 to 3. Tap a card to hear the word, swipe to see the next one. Big friendly pictures, one word at a time, and a clear voice that says it out loud. No menus, no timers, no scores – just words. Everything in the app is free. First Words Pro, with new packs every month and more voices, is coming soon

posts.name: Knola
posts.tagline: Turn what you know into a video course. No camera needed.
posts.description: Type what you know. Knola writes the lessons, builds the slides and narrates every video in an AI voice or your own. Then it makes the ebook, sales funnel, sales page and checkout. Nothing to record. Pay once, no monthly fee. Start free, no card.

posts.name: Bapum
posts.tagline: Tactile-only stress relief. No screen. No noise. Just calm.
posts.description: The Bapum method supports the regulation of your nervous system and your emotions through a gentle physical heartbeat. The heartbeat is felt on the skin, so it needs no screen, no sound and no attention. While most apps tax your attention and mind, Bapum communicates directly with your body. You don't need to learn new techniques or actively concentrate, just feeling the rhythm is enough. No ads, no registration, no personal data collected. The Bapum method stays free, always.

posts.name: Teleplay AI
posts.tagline: Turn any game idea into a playable game with AI tools
posts.description: Teleplay turns a simple idea into a playable browser game in minutes. We’re obsessed with making game creation faster, more efficient, and radically easier to use — but our bigger vision goes beyond generation. We’re building toward world models that can understand, reason about, and interact with game worlds, so AI can eventually do more than create games: it can truly understand how they work.

posts.name: Out in 20
posts.tagline: Browser escape rooms. 20 minutes. Solo or with friends.
posts.description: Out in 20: escape rooms, a global riddle race and a treasure hunt. Quick puzzle games you can play in your browser, alone or with friends.

posts.name: HtmlDrag
posts.tagline: Edit HTML visually, refine with AI, turn files into webpages
posts.description: Edit existing and AI-generated HTML in one visual workspace. Upload HTML, paste code, or clone a public webpage. Precisely refine selected elements with AI while preserving the surrounding HTML structure, or edit text, images, tables and layouts directly. Turn documents, spreadsheets and slides into editable HTML. Export standalone HTML, download your designs as images for free, or share a preview link.

posts.name: Songwriter Studio
posts.tagline: Keep lyrics, recordings, and song ideas in one workspace
posts.description: Keep a song idea together as it grows. Write lyrics in sections, capture and organize takes, turn audio into editable lyrics, and bring text in from photos. Keep recordings, references and production notes with the song, then refine and export your work. Songwriter Studio is a focused workspace for songwriters who want their ideas to stay easy to find and develop. Works in the browser, with a free plan and optional paid upgrades.

posts.name: AI Cite Who
posts.tagline: Understand why AI recommends competitors and what to improve
posts.description: Understand why AI answers recommend competitors. Inspect buyer-question results, cited sources and competitor evidence, then get a prioritized plan for what to improve on your website and across third-party channels. Start with a free website analysis; AI-answer audits are paid and use selected ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity search configurations.

posts.name: Skryber
posts.tagline: Turn long videos into viral Shorts, Reels & TikToks fast
posts.description: Skryber is an AI video editor that turns one long video into scroll-stopping Shorts, Reels, and TikToks — speaker-tracked reframing, karaoke captions, AI thumbnails, dubbing in 30+ languages, and 4K exports. Free to start, no credit card required.

posts.name: claude-tg-bot
posts.tagline: Run parallel Claude Code sessions from your phone
posts.description: Open-source Telegram bot that drives the Claude Code CLI on your own Linux or WSL machine. Start sessions in any project folder and run them in parallel, answer Claude's questions and permission prompts with buttons, and pick up the same tmux session at your desk.
